questions.question_text:
The table gives the capacities of a flow network.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccc} \text{From / To} & D & E & F & G & H \\ \hline D & - & 6 & - & - & 8 \\ E & - & - & - & - & - \\ F & 12 & - & - & 19 & - \\ G & - & - & - & - & 14 \\ H & - & 22 & - & - & - \end{array}$
Which description gives all the directed edges and capacities needed to construct the network?

options.why: Reversed every edge by treating the column heading as the starting vertex.
Swapped the capacities $6$ and $8$ in row $D$.
Omitted $H \to E$ with capacity $22$, although row $H$, column $E$ contains $22$.

questions.solution_text:
Use each row as the starting vertex and each column as the ending vertex.
Draw and label vertices $D, E, F, G, H$, then draw $D \to E$ ($6$), $D \to H$ ($8$), $F \to D$ ($12$), $F \to G$ ($19$), $G \to H$ ($14$) and $H \to E$ ($22$).

options.why: Included the $20$ from edge $S \to A$, but that edge leaves $S$, so it belongs in row $S$, column $A$.
Recorded only one of the two edges leaving $A$, missing the edge $A \to D$ of capacity $11$.
Read down column $A$ instead of across row $A$, recording the edge that enters $A$ rather than those that leave it.

questions.solution_text:
Row $A$ records only the edges directed away from $A$.
These are $A \to C$ ($13$) and $A \to D$ ($11$).
$\begin{array}{c|cccccc} \text{From / To} & S & A & B & C & D & T \\ \hline A & - & - & - & 13 & 11 & - \end{array}$

options.why: The $3$ sits in row $P$, column $Q$, so that edge runs from $P$ to $Q$; drawing $B$ reverses it by reading the column as the starting vertex.
The $5$ is in row $S$, column $P$ and the $7$ in row $S$, column $Q$; drawing $C$ swaps the two capacities leaving $S$.
The $4$ sits in row $Q$, column $T$, so it runs from $Q$ to $T$; drawing $D$ reverses it, which would also leave an edge directed out of the sink.

questions.solution_text:
Row $S$ gives $S \to P$ ($5$) and $S \to Q$ ($7$).
Row $P$ gives $P \to Q$ ($3$) and $P \to T$ ($6$).
Row $Q$ gives $Q \to T$ ($4$).
Drawing $A$ matches every row of the table.

Row $S$ gives the two edges needed to complete the diagram: $S \to A$ with capacity $14$ and $S \to B$ with capacity $26$.

questions.question_text:
The table gives the maximum capacities, in tonnes per hour, of one-way conveyors at a mine.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccc} \text{From / To} & M & R & N & K & H \\ \hline M & - & 120 & 95 & - & - \\ R & - & - & - & 60 & - \\ N & - & - & - & 80 & 45 \\ K & - & - & - & - & 130 \\ H & - & - & - & - & - \end{array}$
Which description gives all the directed edges and capacities needed to construct the network?

options.why: Reversed every conveyor by treating each column heading as the starting vertex.
Swapped the capacities $120$ and $95$ in row $M$.
Omitted the conveyor $N \to H$ with capacity $45$, the second capacity in row $N$.

questions.question_text:
A flow network with six vertices is recorded in this table.
$\begin{array}{c|cccccc} \text{From / To} & A & B & C & D & E & F \\ \hline A & - & 18 & - & - & - & - \\ B & - & - & - & - & 40 & - \\ C & - & 22 & - & - & - & 15 \\ D & 31 & - & 27 & - & - & - \\ E & - & - & - & - & - & - \\ F & - & - & - & - & 12 & - \end{array}$
Which description gives all the directed edges and capacities needed to construct the network?

options.why: Reversed every edge by reading columns as starting vertices and rows as ending vertices.
Swapped the capacities $22$ and $15$ in row $C$.
Put the $12$ edge into $B$ instead of $E$, although $12$ is in row $F$, column $E$.

questions.solution_text:
Draw and label vertices $A, B, C, D, E, F$.
The seven capacities give $A \to B$ ($18$), $B \to E$ ($40$), $C \to B$ ($22$), $C \to F$ ($15$), $D \to A$ ($31$), $D \to C$ ($27$) and $F \to E$ ($12$).

Put the $21$ in column $L$ instead of column $M$; the edge $J \to M$ ends at $M$, and it is $M \to L$ that reaches $L$.

questions.solution_text:
Row $J$ records only the edges directed away from $J$.
These are $J \to K$ ($9$) and $J \to M$ ($21$).
$\begin{array}{c|cccccc} \text{From / To} & G & H & J & K & L & M \\ \hline J & - & - & - & 9 & - & 21 \end{array}$

questions.question_text:
A flow network is recorded in this table.
$\begin{array}{c|cccccc} \text{From / To} & S & A & B & C & D & T \\ \hline S & - & 33 & 29 & - & - & - \\ A & - & - & - & 14 & 12 & - \\ B & - & - & - & - & 25 & - \\ C & - & - & - & - & - & 18 \\ D & - & - & - & - & - & 41 \\ T & - & - & - & - & - & - \end{array}$
Which description gives all the directed edges and capacities needed to construct the network?

options.why: Placed the $25$ edge into $C$ instead of $D$, although $25$ is in row $B$, column $D$.
Swapped the capacities $14$ and $12$ in row $A$.
Reversed the capacity $41$ edge: row $D$, column $T$ means $D \to T$, not $T \to D$.

questions.solution_text:
Draw and label vertices $S, A, B, C, D, T$.
Read each capacity from its starting row to its ending column. The complete network has $S \to A$ ($33$), $S \to B$ ($29$), $A \to C$ ($14$), $A \to D$ ($12$), $B \to D$ ($25$), $C \to T$ ($18$) and $D \to T$ ($41$).
